title: OutLayer 솔로 #046 · glamour hourglass · 블랙 라텍스 슬링 V · 힙 팝 · 계단식 논
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous warm-ivory complexion, mid 40s goddess, glamour hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, waist-length braids natural black hair — wearing a minimal sling micro bikini made entirely of glossy jet-black latex, one continuous garment consisting only of a low-rise micro bikini bottom of one tiny opaque black latex triangle on thin side strings of the same material tied at the hips and the straps that rise from its front: from the front center of that bottom two black latex straps rise and spread apart in a V over her stomach: the left strap runs up to her left breast, where the strap itself widens into a wide flat band exactly where it passes over her left breast, fully and opaquely covering her left nipple and areola, then curving up over its shoulder and meeting the other strap behind her neck; the right strap runs up to her right breast, where the strap itself widens into a wide flat band exactly where it passes over her right breast, fully and opaquely covering her right nipple and areola, then curving up over its shoulder and meeting the other strap behind her neck, these straps alone covering her chest and leaving the rest of her torso bare, every piece with a mirror-wet latex shine, fully opaque and covering only what it must, her stomach bare between the straps. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme — most extreme glamour hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy black latex, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in glossy black lacquer with a high polish.
Piercing: a large gold navel hoop with a big white pearl, resting directly on her skin at her navel.
Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and large drop earrings of mixed metals, a long silver chain ending in a heavy gold anvil-shaped weight on each ear, hanging above her collarbones. Jewelry is metal and pearl only.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Chinese woman (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: defined brown-mauve eyeshadow, a precise winged liner, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, softly contoured cheeks, glossy rose-nude lips.

Background: green stepped rice terraces with a stone path, a waist-high stone wall and a standard-height farm hut door at her side, in warm golden late-afternoon light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
